sources.title: Aaron D. Lauda and Hendryk Pfeiffer, Open-closed strings: Two-dimensional extended TQFTs and Frobenius algebras, arXiv:math/0510664v3
sources.locator: Complete 47-page v3 paper; §§3.1–3.7, PDF pp. 12–39, especially Proposition 3.8–3.10, Propositions 3.11–3.17, Definition 3.20, and the complete Theorem 3.22 proof; §4, pp. 39–42; §5, pp. 42–44.
sources.source_kind_detail: Primary full-text paper. The relevant category, normal-form, and colored-data sections were read in the local PDF/text; diagrams on pp. 18–25 and 32–39 were rendered and inspected.

contents.name: §§3.1–3.3: manifolds with faces, colored boundaries, gluing, generators, and special Morse decomposition
contents.support: The paper fixes the face, corner, source/target, color, collar, and gluing conventions; the local definition states them explicitly and proves the chosen collar operations are independent on relative diffeomorphism classes.

contents.name: §2.1–2.2: Frobenius functional, dual-pairing tensor, and algebra/coalgebra data
contents.support: The source motivates the functional/object correspondence. The local A3 item writes the inverse tensor and expands its counit, coassociativity, Frobenius, uniqueness, and converse contractions.

contents.name: Proposition 3.8–3.9: all local critical-point types and decomposition into the ten maps
contents.support: The source supplies the Morse-chart classification and mixed-saddle route. The local draft constructs the relative function and describes the two mixed incidence patterns; the six typed boundary/color factorizations still need an explicit local case ledger and remain escalated.

contents.name: Proposition 3.10, pp. 20–22: closed/open Frobenius, zipper, centrality, duality, and Cardy relations
contents.support: The source states the elementary relations and leaves direct surface verification implicit. The local draft gives cut-and-match arguments, but does not yet record a distinct seam-edge word and boundary-relative diffeomorphism for every listed relation; this proof obligation remains escalated.

contents.name: Propositions 3.11–3.17, pp. 22–26: pairings, transports, windows, handles, and cozipper moves
contents.support: The source states pairing, transport, window, handle, and cozipper moves, and leaves (3.55) as an exercise. The local draft expands the snakes, pairing transports, cozipper coalgebra map, window/handle slides, and Cardy handle reduction; the full typed colored copairing-invariance transpose still needs an explicit calculation.

contents.name: Definition 3.18 and Theorem 3.22, pp. 26–39: typed normal word and all reduction stages I–XI
contents.support: The complete source proof and its I–XI height/count arguments were read. The local draft records a candidate normal word and the outer termination measures, but the complete diagram-specific typed case ledger for stages II, III, VI–XI is not yet written; the normal-form claim remains escalated.

contents.name: Theorem 4.2, Corollaries 4.3 and 4.6, and Theorem 5.6, pp. 39–44
contents.support: The source states the closed and colored classification and gives only proof indications for the colored case. The local drafts supply extraction, reconstruction, and transformation arguments against the normal-form interface; these consumers remain escalated until the local surface relations and normal-form proof are complete.

contents.name: §5, equation (5.8), PDF p. 43: differently directed Frobenius composites
contents.support: The displayed line chains a final map A_ab⊗A_bd→A_ac⊗A_cd after two maps with codomain A_ab⊗A_bd. The local definition splits the two domain/codomain-compatible equalities and records the correction in batch notes; owner review is still required.

read_evidence.access_method: Reused the complete local v3 PDF/text and extracted the complete source PDF to page-separated text with PyMuPDF; source diagrams were rendered locally.
read_evidence.extent: Relevant full argument: §3.1–3.7, PDF pp. 12–39; all stages I–XI of Theorem 3.22; §4, pp. 39–42; §5 definitions and Theorem 5.6, pp. 42–44. Historical root source-note limits remain unchanged.

sources.title: Joachim Kock, Frobenius algebras and 2D topological quantum field theories, complete minicourse notes
sources.locator: Complete 48-page notes retrieved; §1.1–1.3, PDF pp. 6–18, for closed cobordisms and their generators; §2.4, pp. 25–30, for the inverse-pairing tensor, unique coproduct, counits, Frobenius relation and converse; §3.1.12–3.1.13, pp. 34–36, for the category-level closed TQFT correspondence and maps.
sources.source_kind_detail: Author-hosted full minicourse/lecture-note PDF. It is not represented as the separate 240-page 2003 book.

contents.name: §1: closed cobordisms and symmetric monoidal TQFT convention
contents.support: Independent closed-sector convention; the local item additionally defines the exact free-boundary and corner category.

contents.name: §2.4.2–2.4.12: Frobenius form, copairing, coproduct, counits, Frobenius relation, coassociativity and converse
contents.support: Independent algebraic treatment. The local proof expands the dual-basis and tensor-pairing calculations rather than importing the source's graphical sketches.

contents.name: §3.1.12–3.1.13: closed two-dimensional TQFT/Frobenius equivalence on maps
contents.support: A second full lecture-note treatment of the closed classification; the local proof adds the precise no-free-boundary category, normal form, empty boundaries, and equivalence units/counits.

read_evidence.access_method: Fetched the complete author-hosted PDF and inspected its page-separated local text extraction.
read_evidence.extent: The complete source PDF was retrieved. The full relevant arguments in §§1.1–1.3, 2.4.2–2.4.12, and 3.1.12–3.1.13 were read.

sources.title: Gregory W. Moore and Graeme Segal, D-branes and K-theory in 2D topological field theory, arXiv:hep-th/0609042v1
sources.locator: §2.1–2.4, PDF pp. 5–12, for open/closed objects, boundary labels, algebraic data, Cardy, and the sewing theorem; Appendix A.2, printed pp. 71–80, for the independent Morse-theoretic proof of the open/closed sewing conditions.
sources.source_kind_detail: Primary full-text 89-page expository paper. Its target is complex vector spaces and its boundary-condition category is not identical to the locally defined relative surface category.

contents.name: §2.1–2.4: independently formulated open/closed sewing data and Cardy condition
contents.support: Corroborates the open-sector category, noncommutative symmetric Frobenius algebra, central zipper, adjoint cozipper, and Cardy interface; its complex-field setting is not imported.

contents.name: Appendix A.2: Morse changes and the complete open/closed sewing theorem
contents.support: Independent open/closed Morse-theoretic treatment in a different boundary-condition category. The local draft records a constructive outline but its complete typed case ledger remains escalated; this source is corroboration, not a substitute for the missing local cases.

contents.name: Appendix A.2: boundary-critical and mixed interior/boundary cases
contents.support: Independent check of boundary-critical cases. The local draft names the corresponding generator types and labels, but the six typed mixed-saddle boundary factorizations remain unresolved for owner review.

read_evidence.access_method: Fetched the complete arXiv PDF and inspected its page-separated local text extraction.
read_evidence.extent: The full relevant proof was read: §2.1–2.4, PDF pp. 5–12, and Appendix A.2, printed pp. 71–80. The source's complex-field and category-convention limits are retained.
